editorial:
Imagine you are a career criminal just one job away from retirement, only to find out your boss wants you dead. That is the mess Brian and Charlie find themselves in. After stealing a massive pile of cash, these two buddies have to dodge the cops, scary drug dealers, and a very mad girlfriend. In a desperate move to hide in plain sight, they dress up as nuns and sneak into a convent. The whole vibe is a classic slapstick comedy where the stakes are high, but the situations are absolutely ridiculous. You will love the chemistry between the two leads as they try to act holy while panicking about their lives.

The acting is spot on, and the pacing keeps you laughing without feeling too slow. While some of the jokes feel a bit dated, the sheer absurdity of two thugs pretending to be sisters is timeless. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want something light and silly. If you want the best experience, try renting it on Apple TV or grabbing the Blu-ray for your physical collection to keep the laughs handy. It is a perfect choice if you miss those old-school comedies that do not take themselves too seriously.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the bad guys finally track the duo to the convent. In a chaotic final showdown, the criminals and the police clash in a huge mess. Brian and Charlie use their disguises and the convent layout to trick their enemies. They manage to outsmart the villains and get away with the money. The movie ends with them finally escaping their troubles, proving that sometimes the craziest plan is the only one that works.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and heist movies.
